ledger.x: c. 600 BCE: the Kuru, a janapada around Indraprastha, stand as one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas. 'The Kuru Kingdom was formed in the Middle Vedic period (c. 1200 - c. 900 BCE)' and had become 'something of a backwater' by the Mahajanapada period; -600 is Cliopatria's start of the Mahajanapadas, so the year is a bridge…

c. 345 BCE: the Kuru state ends. The page's infobox runs 'c. 1900 BCE - c. 345 BCE' and 'Disestablished' carries no explanation; the Mahajanapadas page has the Kurus still attested 'in the 4th century BCE' by the Arthashastra and 'The Nandas usurped the throne of Shishunaga dynasty c. 345 BCE' in the same year, but no…

certainty.note: Only the Ganga and Yamuna doab and the Sarasvati/Drishadvati country around Kurukshetra are named; the Panchala and Matsya frontiers are approximate.
